en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 59 - Ahmad bin Ali has narrated from Muhammad bin Husain bin Ismail from Abdur Rahman bin Hajjaj that he said: I heard Abu Ibrahim, Imam Kadhim (a.s) say:
So and so [Bani Abbas] would arrest and imprison me. Then he said: Although this matter would be much prolonged, but it would end in a nice way.
